verdict.rationale: A password manager could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this story applies to Bitwarden. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server, the CLI's `bw serve` API and llms.txt let external agents reach the vault. Those are developer building blocks and agent-facing interfaces, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
